label: Peplink B One 5G
description: Small-business SD-WAN router with an embedded 5G modem: 2x GE WAN, 4x GE LAN, 1 Gbps routing throughput.
notes: Vendor figures from the Peplink tech-spec sheet: 2 GE WAN, 4 GE LAN, router throughput 1 Gbps, plus an embedded 5G modem. The modem is modelled at the conservative 100M class the catalogue uses wherever a cellular category is not stated in the extracted rows - the sheet confirms 5G but the sub-6/mmWave split was not captured, so this figure is a floor rather than a peak.
